remarks: Experience the heart of Downtown SoNo in this extremely spacious, bright, airy, and beautifully updated 1 bed, 1 bath unit offering a bonus loft space! Tucked on a quiet street, this pet-friendly, sun-filled home features soaring ceilings, central air, gleaming hardwood floors, and an open-concept layout ideal for both relaxing and entertaining. The spacious living and dining area flows into a modern kitchen with granite countertops, while the oversized bedroom includes tremendous light, and a generous walk-in closet that can be converted as a home office if needed. A unique lofted space above adds even more flexibility-perfect as a second bedroom space, office, or creative studio. Enjoy rare in-unit laundry, and a pet-friendly building with elevator access and a designated gated & covered parking space, along with ample visitor parking spaces. The perfect mix of urban convenience and peaceful retreat. Just steps from award-winning restaurants, shops, parks, trails, Metro North, I-95, Merritt Pkwy, and the Maritime Aquarium. Private, spacious, and move-in ready; this is SoNo living at its finest!
